tagline: Answers from accessible sources: Users who can access only some of the volumes or MCP connections attached to a Genie Agent are no longer blocked from using it.
what_it_does: Answers from accessible sources: Users who can access only some of the volumes or MCP connections attached to a Genie Agent are no longer blocked from using it. The agent answers using only the sources that the user can access. Custom claims in the Monitor tab: For Genie Agents that an app queries with an OAuth custom identity claim, the Monitor tab can now show each message's claim, so you can tell which of the app's end users asked it.
why_it_matters: Faster benchmark runs: Benchmark questions now run in parallel, so benchmark evaluations finish sooner.
